description.value: Filberg Summer Kitchen is a small, seasonal patio restaurant on the oceanfront grounds of Filberg Heritage Lodge and Park in Comox, run by Dubois Food Co. under Chef Marc-André. The kitchen focuses on from-scratch cooking with locally sourced ingredients from BC farmers, fisherpeople, and producers, with seating on a heated covered waterfront patio. An off-season Dinner Club offers rotating tasting menus with BC wine pairings on select private-event weekends.
